role.letterer: Throws sound effects. On the beat.

inker.tap: ink bolt at the nearest lit ghost
inker.ult: Splash Page: all ink, piercing bolts

penciller.tap: ruler pins a ghost for 2.5 s, even in the dark
penciller.hold: trace a loop to crush pinned ghosts
penciller.ult: Layout: a panel grid freezes every ghost

letterer.tap: throw a word; on the beat POW → KAPOW → KA-BLAMM!
letterer.swipe: WHOOSH dash, letters light the way
letterer.ult: SFX Storm: your longest word falls from the sky

colorist.hold: fill the ink you stand in with colour for 10 s
colorist.ult: Four-Color Process: flats spread and burst

perkDesc.bleed: Dash trails stay inked for 5 s.
perkDesc.drybrush: Half crystal cost, 5.5 m max light.
perkDesc.chiaroscuro: +1 damage at the edge of the light.
perkDesc.spotBlack: Letting go of the crystal fires a ring of bolts.
perkDesc.ricochet: Rulers bounce to a second ghost.
perkDesc.perspective: Loops also hit ghosts that aren't pinned.
perkDesc.blueline: Pencil lines last longer: easier loops.
perkDesc.italics: Words fly faster and lean into ghosts.
perkDesc.kerning: Letters lie on the page for 6 s.
perkDesc.offBeat: Missing the beat keeps your word size.
perkDesc.ellipsis: Words leave three dots that pop.
perkDesc.duotone: Two colours are enough to burst.
perkDesc.goldLeaf: Gold heals faster and drops double ink.
